name: openai/gpt-4o
description: GPT-4o ("o" for "omni") is OpenAI's versatile, high-intelligence GPT model released in May 2024, accepting text and image input and producing text output, including Structured Outputs. OpenAI describes it as fast and flexible, suited to general-purpose chat, image understanding, function calling and non-English language tasks. This entry tracks OpenAI's default GPT-4o alias; use one of the dated GPT-4o snapshots when a workload needs fixed behavior.
